title: Private Meeting for Public Matters
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened to formally announce a closed executive session.
*   This private session was authorized by state law for discussing sensitive topics.
*   Any final decisions or actions stemming from the closed meeting would later be made public.
transcript:
=CITY OF AUSTIN. TEXAS=
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Called Council Meeting
April 25, 1979
4:00 P.M.
Council Chambers
301 West Second Street
The meeting was called to order with Mayor McClellan presiding. Roll Call: Present: Mayor
McClellan, Mayor Pro Tern Goodman, Councilmembers Cooke, Himmelblau, Mullen, Snell,
Trevino
Absent:
None
Mayor McClellan opened the meeting scheduled for 4:00 P.M., stating that this was a
Special Called Meeting of the City Council for the purpose of publicly announcing that it
will convene in a closed or executive session authorized by Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f)
and (g) of Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated; and after such closed
or executive session any final action, decision or vote with regard to any matter
considered in the closed or executive session would be made in open session, should such
action, decision or vote be necessary.
Mayor McClellan announced that the Council would go into executive session at this time to
consider the items authorized in Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated. APPROVE
Mayor
ATTEST:
City Clerk
